10:48pm: MI rise to No. 3, with their NRR better than RCB's. SRH's season goes 
continues to plummet. This was a no contest. The game was effectively done in the first 
innings. Rohit started well, Jacks stitched a healthy partnership before SKY came in to 
build on the platform. Cummins was taken down in the powerplay, Unadkat got 
Rickelton cheaply but there were no chances created. Rohit's pulls were back on show, 
he lifted balls over cover and helped them behind square. SKY's sweeps were in flow 
too. They decided at the second timeout that they will hurry to the win and that's what 
they did. 
Pat Cummins, SRH captain: Klaasen and Abhinav did well for us to get to a total. Never 
got going. After a couple of wickets, you have to find a way to steady the ship. Couldn't 
do that. (Was there pressure to score high on this pitch) We spoke about the pitch 
before the match. You're allowed to bowl a good over, build your innings and you can 
catch up. You have to start 0 for 0, it's about assessing the pitch each time you play. 
The difference between the first game where we got 280-plus and the next, where we 
folded, was big. That's T20, you don't know what happens. Hasn't worked out so far. We 
have a few away games now. It's about assessing each wicket quickly. Some days it 
might be all-out attack and there'll be graft on others. 
Suryakumar Yadav: Wife's flown down from Mumbai, what could be better. It was really 
important to come positive. Having won four in a row is special. Rohit made my job 
easier, I just had to bat with a good tempo. Him coming to form is great. You keep 
practicing the sweep in the nets, do the same in the game. It's less risk, high reward. 
Praveen: "Something to do with SRH and over 16. They are either all out in 16 overs or 
opponents chanse down SRH target in 16 overs." 
ShahSafeer: "Please hand PotM award the most deserving one, Trent Boult." 
Hardik Pandya, MI captain: Good to have a win. Glad the boys are taking the 
momentum in the right way.. I've felt, once everyone starts clicking in this team there 
will be domination. Deepak, Boult set it up; Rohit, SKY finished it. Overall, a wonderful 
win. (Deepak four in a row) Realised captaincy sometimes is about instincts, want to 
see and react and not always pre-plan. In a situation like this where he bowled 
wonderfully in the powerplay, then why hold his fourth over back? (Boxes left to tick) 
Just need to get better in all departments. So far, very satisfied. 
Trent Boult, POTM: Nice to contribute to a good win in a big name. To keep a quality 
side down in their home conditions was the most satisfying. Deepak did a great job, 
nice to see a couple of catches being held. I'd love to bowl four in a row and swing it 
around but it doesn't always happen. You have to be ready to bowl in whatever stage 
you're asked. Slightly different role this year, but I've enjoyed my time so far and want to 
continue. Yorker is a low-percentage ball, in my opinion, there has been a few more 
bowled this season. As some of the older-fashion players used to say, you can't beat a 
good yorker. (What makes you tick?) I still love the feeling of taking wickets and getting 
into the battle, there'd be hundreds and thousands of players wanting to play. So, don't 
want to take opportunities for granted. 
A comprehensive win. They continue their ascent and are now into the top-half of the 
table. There could be more traffic there tomorrow as RCB face RR tomorrow. See you 
for that. Thanks for joining in tonight. I'm Ekanth, signing off on behalf of Sudarshanan, 
and our scorers, M Venkat Raghav and K Vairavan.
